question: In which year were the two most common causes of traffic accidents different from those in other years?
sql:
SELECT 
    ci.db_year,
    c.pcf_violation_category as top_cause,
    COUNT(*) as count
FROM case_ids ci
JOIN collisions c ON ci.case_id = c.case_id
WHERE c.pcf_violation_category IS NOT NULL AND c.pcf_violation_category != ''
GROUP BY ci.db_year, c.pcf_violation_category
QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ci.db_year ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) <= 2
ORDER BY ci.db_year
